question: Name the book released at the Indian Navy Chiefs' Conclave 2025 held at Naval Headquarters, New Delhi.

options.text: Legacy of Leadership: Naval Chiefs through Time

solution:
The correct answer is __**Legacy of Leadership: Naval Chiefs through Time.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Book "Legacy of Leadership: Naval Chiefs through Time" was released at the Indian Navy Chiefs' Conclave 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The book chronicles the inspiring journeys of former Indian Navy Chiefs (CNSs).
 
• It offers personal stories, rare photographs, and firsthand accounts from the leadership of past Naval Chiefs.
 
• The book was launched on the sidelines of the Indian Navy Chiefs’ Conclave 2025.
 
• It provides unique insights into the leadership of the former CNSs, contributing to the institutional continuity of the Indian Navy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Navy Chiefs’ Conclave__

 __
 
• A gathering of former and current Indian Navy Chiefs aimed at leveraging collective experience and sharing insights on current developments.
 
• Discussions focused on technological advancements, operational updates, and maritime strategy for future leadership.
 
 
 
• Legacy of Leadership__
 
 
• The book reflects on the leadership and contributions of past Navy Chiefs, enhancing the understanding of India's maritime history.
 
• It underscores the commitment of the Indian Navy to carry forward its legacy while adapting to modern geopolitical and strategic challenges.
